# LLMFlow

> Local LLM request tracing, tokens, cost and latency. No account or login required.

## Install and run

Install Bun first. The npm launcher uses Node.js to run the Bun server:

```bash
npx llmflow
```

From source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/HelgeSverre/llmflow.git
cd llmflow
bun install
bun run build
bun run start
```

For development, run `bun run dev` after installation. The dashboard Vite server proxies API/WebSocket requests to the Bun server.

Dashboard and OTLP default to http://localhost:1337. Proxy defaults to http://localhost:8080. Occupied configured ports fail startup; there is no automatic fallback port. `DASHBOARD_PORT` and `PROXY_PORT` override these ports. Set the SDK's `LLMFLOW_URL` when changing the dashboard endpoint.

## Integrations

- OpenAI-compatible base URL: http://localhost:8080/v1
- Native Anthropic base URL: http://localhost:8080/passthrough/anthropic
- Native OpenAI base URL: http://localhost:8080/passthrough/openai
- Native Gemini base URL: http://localhost:8080/passthrough/gemini
- OTLP/HTTP JSON or protobuf: POST http://localhost:1337/v1/traces, /v1/logs and /v1/metrics; gzip is supported. The receiver does not implement OTLP/gRPC.
- JavaScript SDK: `llmflow-sdk`, with TypeScript declarations; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:1337.
- Trace spans with session.id can be grouped in Sessions. Timeline displays traces and logs; Metrics has a separate tab.

Provider credentials must be supplied through the client or the supported provider environment variables. The tool is intended for local development; it has no built-in authentication. SQLite stores captured data locally.

## Current documentation

- [README](https://github.com/HelgeSverre/llmflow/blob/main/README.md): startup, providers, configuration, packaging and testing.
- [Integration examples](https://github.com/HelgeSverre/llmflow/tree/main/examples): runnable examples and setup.
- [AI CLI integration guide](https://github.com/HelgeSverre/llmflow/blob/main/docs/guides/ai-cli-tools.md): native proxy and telemetry configuration.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/HelgeSverre/llmflow/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): current module responsibilities.

## Source map

- apps/server/src/server.ts: Bun dashboard/API/OTLP routing and startup.
- apps/server/src/proxy.ts: provider request forwarding and capture.
- packages/db/src/index.ts: SQLite schema, persistence and queries.
- packages/providers/src/: TypeScript/ESM provider adapters and StreamSession.
- packages/otlp/src/: CommonJS ingestion, HTTP transport decoding and upstream export.
- packages/pricing/src/: LiteLLM pricing with a bundled fallback.
- packages/sdk/: JavaScript tracing SDK and declarations.
- apps/dashboard/src/: Svelte 5 UI, stores and trace viewer.
- public/: generated dashboard assets.
- bin/llmflow.js: Node launcher; dist/server.js is the bundled Bun server in npm distributions.
